source_notes: Both English and Tamil 2025 Term I books were used. Unit 4 uses printed pages 149–157 in both editions.

The Tamil and English texts differ slightly in phrasing around some trade items; bilingual questions preserve the common source-supported meaning.
meta.question_style: Natural competitive-exam wording; no routine 'according to the textbook' phrasing.
